sensors.name: line tracker, brightness of the floor in %

functions: followLine (defined in b4, called in b3)

actions.name: curve left (left wheel 20 %, right wheel 50 %) when the tracker sees black
curve left (left wheel 20 %, right wheel 50 %) when the tracker does not see black

control_flow: followLine: if the line tracker reads less than 50 % (black), curve left; else curve left as well.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line from the start, through its bends, to the green goal at its end, without leaving the line.

decision_points.condition: the line tracker's brightness under the robot is below 50 % (a black line)

branches.outcome: black: it curves left (left wheel 20 %, right wheel 50 %)
not black: it also curves left (left wheel 20 %, right wheel 50 %)

input_dimensions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line
the line's course from the start to the goal

scenarios.coded_response: Whatever the tracker reads, it curves left with the left wheel at 20 % and the right at 50 %: it never steers right.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on the black line, facing along it; the line runs on with bends and ends in a green goal area.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then the white band, then black again, along the way
scenarios.title: Follows the line to the green goal at its end
assumptions: The green goal is a goal area placed at the end of the line.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line, also through its bends, without leaving it, until it reaches the green goal at the line's end.

uncertainties: Both outcomes of the only decision curve left with the same wheels, so the program can never steer right and cannot hold a line that bends to the right.
You didn't say where exactly the green goal is, except that it is at the line's end.
